Thanks Connor — great summary. Quick responses below.

1) Co-sell PM: I'll own the regional co-sell coordination for this account (Priya Sharma). I'll loop in the Marketplace intake team for listing validation. Primary intake contact: marketplace-intake@google.com.

2) Listing governance steps to expect:
   - Security artifacts: SOC2 Type II attestation or equivalent + data flow diagram + encryption details. If those aren't available, we can accept an audit plan but it will push listing dates.
   - Billing: vendor tax paperwork and W-9 (US) are required before public listing.
   - Listing taxonomy: we should align on product SKU granularity; please include the desired plan tiers in the MAP (we can advise).

3) Timeline: Intake reviews typically take 7-10 business days once artifacts are complete. If Redwood can deliver the security package by 6/22, we can target marketplace intake on 6/24 and a soft listing approval by 7/15.

I can do a 30-min sync Thursday 11am PT. Is that OK?
